newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerages to change buy-back rules - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerages to change buy-back rules - paper.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Nikko Securities Co Ltd and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd plan to change their company rules to make it easier to buy back up to 10 percent of their shares, a Japanese business daily reported.
Nomura wants to buy back up to 190 million of its shares, Nikko 140 million and Yamaichi 120 million, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday.
The planned purchases would be aimed at strengthening the companies' financial health, the paper said.
Japan's fourth major brokerage, Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, is planning to buy back its own shares to introduce a stock option scheme for its executives and other employees, the newspaper said.
The securities houses were not immediately available for comment on the report.
